description: This file contains utility functions for managing and analyzing TypeScript and JavaScript files in a repository, including file collection, path resolution, and AST analysis functions.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazy loads and caches the TypeScript module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Resolves the root directory of the repository given an import meta URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Resolves an array of source root directories based on the repository root and relative paths.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path resembles a test-related TypeScript file based on suffixes.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target path, optionally including test files and skipping node_modules.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Aggregates TypeScript files from multiple source root directories.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Scans files for violations based on provided criteria.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Converts a source file node to its line number.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts the text from property name nodes.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Unwraps nested expression wrappers like parentheses or type assertions.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Collects line numbers of call expressions within a source file AST.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Determines if the script is run directly or imported as a module.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Executes a main function if the script is run directly.
